manifest.provenance: Hand-drawn approximate boundaries for the Gadded PoC. NOT an authoritative Egyptian GIS dataset (no IDA industrial-zone boundary, no official EEAA protected-area layer, no real grid/substation data was available for this hackathon timebox). Coordinates are illustrative approximations of real place names, sized to demonstrate point-in-polygon and distance screening on the golden case and one alternate scenario.
manifest.coverage: Two named industrial zones only; nothing outside their extents is covered.
limitations: Not authoritative — do not use for real site selection or permitting.
Substation and road features are illustrative points/lines, not verified grid infrastructure.
Protected-area polygon is a synthetic placeholder, not a real EEAA-designated boundary.
